_comment_scope: T-678 owner decision 2026-08-08: per-character on the achievement-credit seam; account-wide is a possible later migration (schema keeps it cheap), do not build it here.
_comment_pacing: FFXIV-like duration target WITHOUT its daily throttle: no cap/lockout anywhere — a 6-hour Saturday banks 6 hours of renown. Exalted = 11000/50 = 220 hub quest turn-ins (~weeks of normal play, tunable here).
_comment_hubs: Hub attribution: quests carry no zone field, so the turn-in NPC id prefix is the hub signal (see RenownStore.hub_for_quest). Per already-shipped zone hub only; add hubs here as zones ship.
